title: The runbook, as type
summary: A 64px claim (after handover, one person keeps it healthy), one lede on how the runbook is made and who does the checks on retainer, the link to How an engagement runs under the lede, then the runbook's standing page as 28px type under a running line that carries the draft status — Each week / Each month / Each quarter in the runbook's own words.

reference.borrowed: Interval, then the checks, nothing else.
reference.kelwin: Kit claim and key voice; intervals aligned to the recommended cadence on /about#cadence.

motion: entrance: the claim and lede rise (kit), the three intervals rise in turn, the foot fades in.
notes: Coherence pass 2 (D6): the runbook says “Retune the Orchestration Rules…” (was “the routing rules”). Round 9 fix: the label no longer restates the head ('Standing checks'); 'run' is no longer said three times; 'operator' is gone from the prose; the status and the link sit where this page's form puts them (the runbook's running line; under the lede), not in a foot row shared with the siblings. Coherence pass 3: the quarterly runbook line no longer names a document the page never introduces (the CRM blueprint): “Check your CRM’s stages and fields against how deals actually moved.”
